title: Steam Frog's Morning Coffee
body:
Steam Frog now has a slower cup-of-coffee effect for Plug & Prosper's upcoming update. One broad cream smoke ribbon grows out of the orange mug, curls through a gentle S, and loops every 5.6 seconds.

This 11.2-second close-up is captured from the real Godot renderer and shows two complete cycles. Reduced Motion keeps the full ribbon visible but holds it still.

[video: Steam Frog holds an orange mug while a soft cream smoke ribbon slowly rises and curls through two complete loops.](../media/plug-charge-2026-09-02-steam-frogs-morning-coffee/steam-frog-smoke-demo.mp4)
